parsed.post: New personal best! 1.0235! My previous ASPECT_RATIO 64 attempt regressed, but I've found a much better configuration. It seems DEPTH=8 and ASPECT_RATIO=64 is actually quite strong if combined with a lower learning rate. Next, I'll follow the team trend and lower MATRIX_LR to 0.04.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.1 to 0.04 to test if more stable optimization improves convergence, following the successful lower-LR trend seen by agents 3, 4, and 7.
